## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Graphics + ACF

```{r}
aus_production |> autoplot(Beer)
aus_production |> gg_season(Beer)
aus_production |> ACF(Beer) |> autoplot()
```

## 2. Benchmarks vs SES

```{r}
train <- aus_production |> filter_index(. ~ "2008 Q4")
fit <- train |>
  model(
    snaive = SNAIVE(Beer),
    ses = ETS(Beer ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N"))
  )
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = 8)
fc |> accuracy(aus_production)
```

## 3. Residuals

```{r}
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```
